questions.answer: There is nothing to do on campus. You are only introduced to exchange students from Law School, not other faculties.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nothing. You are only allowed to join athletic activities if you are enrolled for minimum two semesters. There is a gym though.

questions.answer: Get away from campus. Go downtown or a weekend away from Toronto.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: I would recommend applying for University of Toronto instead. Thats downtown, exchangestudents from different faculties are introduced to each other an there are more social events.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Stay downtown instead of on Campus. Try to meet other exchange students. It can be hard though, since you are only introduced to people at Osgoode (Law faculty)

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Experiencing the City of Toronto. Great city.
